woke up late not early but late I woke up around 10 a.m. I was so sleepy I went to bed last night around 11 p.m. and I woke up at 10 a.m. that means I had 11 hours of sleep last night I usually don't haven't had so much energy lately so I take care of myself and I try to get as much rest as I can like one of my students said a good night sleep is only half the battle so as long as I get a good night sleep I think everything else will be perfect and luckily I could sleep in late this morning because I didn't have any early morning lessons to teach I could sleep in late because I didn't have wait and I wait but I can't fall asleep sometimes and it's especially from frustrating when I have an early class in the morning when I have to wake up early because then I don't get my full 8 hours of sleep and without my 8 hours of sleep I can't function I can't go to the gym or teach my lessons or hang out with my friends if I don't get my full 8 hours of sleep how many hours of sleep do you need do you get enough sleep I try to sleep early like 10 10 p.m. is early for me but on the weekends like Saturday and Sunday when I don't work I go to sleep around 2 or even 3 a.m. sometimes but 4 a.m. is the latest that I will go to sleep at and if I go to sleep late I usually try to take a nap a short nap during the day I like to take naps if I didn't get a good night sleep but sometimes short naps make me even more sleepy do you like taking naps during the day or do naps make you feel more sleepy I can take a 20 minute map and I'll Fe feel better but if I take a 40 minute nap then I end up feeling more tired than I did before I'm so jealous of people who can fall asleep easily there are people that can fall asleep so quickly in a matter of minutes they can pass out and be in deep Sleep it's crazy I wish I could fall asleep that fast it's a true Talent can you fall asleep easily or do you take more time to fall asleep I normally have to stop watching my phone or a screen maybe 30 minutes before I go to sleep otherwise I just can't can't sleep the screen on my phone or computer wakes me up and keeps me awake but when I am sick maybe I have a cough or I'm feeling congested I take medication to help with my sickness but also helps me to fall asleep some medicine can cause sleepiness or drowsiness the feeling of sleepiness and I love medicine that makes me feel drowsy then I am able to sleep so well but once I took medicine that caused sleepiness and that night I sleepwalked I used to sleep walk all the time when I was little I I would walk around and talk all while I was still sleeping one time I woke up in my parents bedroom and I was standing right in front of them and I was just talking my parents were so confused and and when I woke up standing there I was also confused I didn't know where I was or how I got there do you ever sleep walk are you a Sleep Walker tell me about a time when you sleepwalked at night but I don't Sleepwalk anymore I only talk in my sleep sometimes sometimes it can scare people people can get scared when I am talking alone at night but I'm just dreaming out loud do you ever talk in your sleep before sleeping I always wash my And subscribe for more content and you will probably like these videos as well thank you for watching bye [Music]
